connector.name: Kaidn
connector.registryDescription: Explain fraud verdicts with evidence, surface account rings, and see who has burned other operators.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.kaidn, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: KAIDN_API_KEY

env.name: KAIDN_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES

env.name: KAIDN_MCP_MAX_QUOTA_CALLS
env.description: Ceiling on quota-consuming calls per process

recipes.cli: claude mcp add kaidn --env KAIDN_API_KEY=<your-kaidn-api-key> --env KAIDN_API_URL=https://api.kaidn.io --env KAIDN_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES=<kaidn-mcp-allow-writes> --env KAIDN_MCP_MAX_QUOTA_CALLS=100 -- npx -y @kaidn/mcp@0.2.2

recipes.code:
[mcp_servers.kaidn]
command = "npx"
args = ["-y", "@kaidn/mcp@0.2.2"]

[mcp_servers.kaidn.env]
KAIDN_API_KEY = "<your-kaidn-api-key>"
KAIDN_API_URL = "https://api.kaidn.io"
KAIDN_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES = "<kaidn-mcp-allow-writes>"
KAIDN_MCP_MAX_QUOTA_CALLS = "100"
